functions.name: get_shared_official_club_name(text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_shared_official_club_name(p_share_token text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT shared_read_private.official_club_name(p_share_token) $function$

functions.name: shared_read_private.official_club_name(text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION shared_read_private.official_club_name(p_share_token text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT c.name
 FROM public.official_events oe JOIN public.clubs c ON c.id=oe.club_id
 WHERE p_share_token IS NOT NULL AND btrim(p_share_token)<>''
   AND oe.share_token=p_share_token AND oe.share_enabled=true
   AND oe.status='closed' AND coalesce(oe.is_deleted,false)=false
 LIMIT 1
$function$
